title: Fail repair safely without false VERIFIED
notes: Wrapped _execute_repair_pipeline with comprehensive exception handling to record REPAIR_FAILED on unexpected errors and update database.

Ensured all gate and test failure paths record specific failure statuses (NEEDS_REVIEW, REPAIR_GATE_REJECTED, POLICY_VIOLATION, TARGETED_TESTS_FAILED, FULL_SUITE_FAILED) in controller_db and never mark bugs as VERIFIED.
